meta.question: For which local products is there a matrix functor M_c(G) = c_E I + c_A A + c_N (J - I - A) (c_A != c_N) with M_c(G*H) = M_c(G) (x) M_c(H) (multiplicative character) or M_c(G*H) = M_c(G) (x) I + I (x) M_c(H) (additive character) for all graphs?
